VM - Type Code to CalcExpress Data Type.vi

Owning Palette: Advanced VarMan VIs

Converts a numeric data type code to CalcExpress Data Type enum.
See Data types topic for details.

Click the parameters for more information

 

type code (1) is VarMan data type code.
CalcExpress Data Type returns Enum with predefined data types:

0String
1DBL Number
2identifier
31D Array of DBL
42D Array of DBL
5CDB Number
61D Array of CDB
72D Array of CDB
81D Array of String
92D Array of String
10Unknown data type
